map.由浓度求 pH（本页代码口径）：pH=−log₁₀[H⁺]；由 pH 反求 [H: pH from concentration (per this page's code): pH=−log₁₀[H⁺]; from pH back to [H⁺]=10^(−pH), pOH=14−pH, [OH⁻]=10^(−pOH) (water ion product at 25°C Kw=1.0×10⁻¹⁴). Validation: [H⁺]≤0 or pH∉[0,14] shows an invalid toast and stops. Grading: pH<3 strong acid, 3≤pH<6 weak acid, 6≤pH<7 slightly acidic, pH=7 neutral, 7<pH≤8 slightly basic, 8<pH≤11 weak base, >11 strong base; the indicator bar is positioned by pH÷14.
map.pOH 判读（与上式互补，共用 Kw=1.0×10⁻¹⁴）：pOH=14−pH；: pOH interpretation (complementary to the formula above, sharing Kw=1.0×10⁻¹⁴): pOH=14−pH; [OH⁻]=10^(−pOH) (mol/L); [H⁺]×[OH⁻] at 25°C always equals 10⁻¹⁴, and pH mode outputs [H⁺], [OH⁻] and pOH together. Validation: [H⁺] mode requires [H⁺]>0; pH mode requires 0≤pH≤14. Grading: pH+pOH=14; at pH=7 [H⁺]=[OH⁻]=10⁻⁷ is the neutral point, and the further it deviates the stronger the acidity or alkalinity.
map.缓冲液 Henderson-Hasselbalch 式（本页代码口径）：pH=p: Buffer Henderson-Hasselbalch equation (per this page's code): pH=pKa+log₁₀([salt]÷[acid])=pKa+log₁₀(cb÷ca); pKa is chosen by buffer system — acetic acid 4.76, dihydrogen/hydrogen phosphate 7.20, carbonic acid 6.35, ammonia/ammonium 9.25. Validation: acid and base concentrations must both be >0, otherwise an invalid toast appears and it stops. Grading: no fixed tiers; when [salt]=[acid] pH=pKa, and every 10-fold change in the ratio shifts pH by 1 unit.
